dataset.description: v0.1 ablation split rebuilt exactly (first records of earliest weekly files)

caveats: Test split is 750 samples spanning ~30 hours; indicative only.
Legacy features suffer the train/serve mismatch documented in the model card.

Novelty AUROC here uses the SHIPPED detector (checkpoint's 10 prototypes/class). The published 0.601 came from select_embedding_dimension.py, which refit 12 prototypes/class and calibrated tau on the test benign set (test leakage for its tau-based metrics); that detector was never deployed.
